WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),PUCHASED_UNITS)),0) PUCHASED_UNITS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),SOLD_UNITS)),0) SOLD_UNITS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),REALIZED_GAIN)),0) REALIZED_GAIN_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NO_UNITS_LEFT)),0) NO_UNITS_LEFT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACCRUED_INTREST)),0) ACCRUED_INTREST_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),INVESTMENT_AMT)),0) INVESTMENT_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),GROSS_AMT)),0) GROSS_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACCRUED_INT_AMT)),0) ACCRUED_INT_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE)),0) AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NOMINAL_AMT)),0) NOMINAL_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),MATURITY_AMT)),0) MATURITY_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),REALIZED_GAIN_AVG)),0) REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS)),0) REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS)),0) REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TOTAL_COMMISSION)),0) TOTAL_COMMISSION_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE)),0) TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TAX_AMT)),0) TAX_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CHARGE_AMT)),0) CHARGE_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),MARKETVALUE)),0) MARKETVALUE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),FX_REALIZED_GAIN)),0) FX_REALIZED_GAIN_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG)),0) FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),UNITS_ALLOTTED)),0) UNITS_ALLOTTED_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),EXERCISE_QTY)),0) EXERCISE_QTY_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),HOLDING_PERIOD)),0) HOLDING_PERIOD_tgt


, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_NONUITFTRANMST WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, PUCHASED_UNITS PUCHASED_UNITS_src
, SOLD_UNITS SOLD_UNITS_src
, REALIZED_GAIN REALIZED_GAIN_src
, NO_UNITS_LEFT NO_UNITS_LEFT_src
, ACCRUED_INTREST ACCRUED_INTREST_src
, INVESTMENT_AMT INVESTMENT_AMT_src
, GROSS_AMT GROSS_AMT_src
, ACCRUED_INT_AMT ACCRUED_INT_AMT_src
, AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src
, NOMINAL_AMT NOMINAL_AMT_src
, MATURITY_AMT MATURITY_AMT_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_src
, TOTAL_COMMISSION TOTAL_COMMISSION_src
, TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src
, TAX_AMT TAX_AMT_src
, CHARGE_AMT CHARGE_AMT_src
, MARKETVALUE MARKETVALUE_src
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN FX_REALIZED_GAIN_src
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src
, UNITS_ALLOTTED UNITS_ALLOTTED_src
, EXERCISE_QTY EXERCISE_QTY_src
, HOLDING_PERIOD HOLDING_PERIOD_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_NONUITFTRANMST WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, PUCHASED_UNITS_tgt
, SOLD_UNITS_tgt
, REALIZED_GAIN_tgt
, NO_UNITS_LEFT_tgt
, ACCRUED_INTREST_tgt
, INVESTMENT_AMT_tgt
, GROSS_AMT_tgt
, ACCRUED_INT_AMT_tgt
, AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt
, NOMINAL_AMT_tgt
, MATURITY_AMT_tgt
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_tgt
, REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_tgt
, TOTAL_COMMISSION_tgt
, TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt
, TAX_AMT_tgt
, CHARGE_AMT_tgt
, MARKETVALUE_tgt
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN_tgt
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt
, UNITS_ALLOTTED_tgt
, EXERCISE_QTY_tgt
, HOLDING_PERIOD_tgt
, PUCHASED_UNITS_src
, SOLD_UNITS_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_src
, NO_UNITS_LEFT_src
, ACCRUED_INTREST_src
, INVESTMENT_AMT_src
, GROSS_AMT_src
, ACCRUED_INT_AMT_src
, AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src
, NOMINAL_AMT_src
, MATURITY_AMT_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_src
, TOTAL_COMMISSION_src
, TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src
, TAX_AMT_src
, CHARGE_AMT_src
, MARKETVALUE_src
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN_src
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src
, UNITS_ALLOTTED_src
, EXERCISE_QTY_src
, HOLDING_PERIOD_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(PUCHASED_UNITS_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) PUCHASED_UNITS_tgt
,CAST(SOLD_UNITS_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) SOLD_UNITS_tgt
,CAST(REALIZED_GAIN_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) REALIZED_GAIN_tgt
,CAST(NO_UNITS_LEFT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) NO_UNITS_LEFT_tgt
,CAST(ACCRUED_INTREST_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) ACCRUED_INTREST_tgt
,CAST(INVESTMENT_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) INVESTMENT_AMT_tgt
,CAST(GROSS_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) GROSS_AMT_tgt
,CAST(ACCRUED_INT_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) ACCRUED_INT_AMT_tgt
,CAST(AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt
,CAST(NOMINAL_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) NOMINAL_AMT_tgt
,CAST(MATURITY_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) MATURITY_AMT_tgt
,CAST(REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt
,CAST(REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_tgt
,CAST(REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_tgt
,CAST(TOTAL_COMMISSION_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) TOTAL_COMMISSION_tgt
,CAST(TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt
,CAST(TAX_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) TAX_AMT_tgt
,CAST(CHARGE_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) CHARGE_AMT_tgt
,CAST(MARKETVALUE_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) MARKETVALUE_tgt
,CAST(FX_REALIZED_GAIN_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) FX_REALIZED_GAIN_tgt
,CAST(FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt
,CAST(UNITS_ALLOTTED_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) UNITS_ALLOTTED_tgt
,CAST(EXERCISE_QTY_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) EXERCISE_QTY_tgt
,CAST(HOLDING_PERIOD_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) HOLDING_PERIOD_tgt

,CAST(PUCHASED_UNITS_src AS numeric(25,5)) PUCHASED_UNITS_src
,CAST(SOLD_UNITS_src AS numeric(25,5)) SOLD_UNITS_src
,CAST(REALIZED_GAIN_src AS numeric(25,5)) REALIZED_GAIN_src
,CAST(NO_UNITS_LEFT_src AS numeric(25,5)) NO_UNITS_LEFT_src
,CAST(ACCRUED_INTREST_src AS numeric(25,5)) ACCRUED_INTREST_src
,CAST(INVESTMENT_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) INVESTMENT_AMT_src
,CAST(GROSS_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) GROSS_AMT_src
,CAST(ACCRUED_INT_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) ACCRUED_INT_AMT_src
,CAST(AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src AS numeric(25,5)) AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src
,CAST(NOMINAL_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) NOMINAL_AMT_src
,CAST(MATURITY_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) MATURITY_AMT_src
,CAST(REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src AS numeric(25,5)) REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src
,CAST(REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_src AS numeric(25,5)) REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_src
,CAST(REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_src AS numeric(25,5)) REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_src
,CAST(TOTAL_COMMISSION_src AS numeric(25,5)) TOTAL_COMMISSION_src
,CAST(TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src AS numeric(25,5)) TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src
,CAST(TAX_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) TAX_AMT_src
,CAST(CHARGE_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) CHARGE_AMT_src
,CAST(MARKETVALUE_src AS numeric(25,5)) MARKETVALUE_src
,CAST(FX_REALIZED_GAIN_src AS numeric(25,5)) FX_REALIZED_GAIN_src
,CAST(FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src AS numeric(25,5)) FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src
,CAST(UNITS_ALLOTTED_src AS numeric(25,5)) UNITS_ALLOTTED_src
,CAST(EXERCISE_QTY_src AS numeric(25,5)) EXERCISE_QTY_src
,CAST(HOLDING_PERIOD_src AS numeric(25,5)) HOLDING_PERIOD_src

,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, PUCHASED_UNITS_src
, SOLD_UNITS_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_src
, NO_UNITS_LEFT_src
, ACCRUED_INTREST_src
, INVESTMENT_AMT_src
, GROSS_AMT_src
, ACCRUED_INT_AMT_src
, AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src
, NOMINAL_AMT_src
, MATURITY_AMT_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_src
, REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_src
, TOTAL_COMMISSION_src
, TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_src
, TAX_AMT_src
, CHARGE_AMT_src
, MARKETVALUE_src
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN_src
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_src
, UNITS_ALLOTTED_src
, EXERCISE_QTY_src
, HOLDING_PERIOD_src
 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, PUCHASED_UNITS_tgt
, SOLD_UNITS_tgt
, REALIZED_GAIN_tgt
, NO_UNITS_LEFT_tgt
, ACCRUED_INTREST_tgt
, INVESTMENT_AMT_tgt
, GROSS_AMT_tgt
, ACCRUED_INT_AMT_tgt
, AVG_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt
, NOMINAL_AMT_tgt
, MATURITY_AMT_tgt
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt
, REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_GROSS_tgt
, REALIZED_GAIN_FIFO_GROSS_tgt
, TOTAL_COMMISSION_tgt
, TXN_PRICE_INCLUDING_FEE_tgt
, TAX_AMT_tgt
, CHARGE_AMT_tgt
, MARKETVALUE_tgt
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN_tgt
, FX_REALIZED_GAIN_AVG_tgt
, UNITS_ALLOTTED_tgt
, EXERCISE_QTY_tgt
, HOLDING_PERIOD_tgt
 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
